description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'EmployeeMembershipAPITest' for testing the EmployeeMembershipAPI endpoints in the OrangeHRM system. It includes multiple test methods to verify get, create, update, delete functionalities along with validation rules, involving mock services and data fixtures.
